BestFriends_SwordInStone/FTUE_Merl_BF_01.en: Talk to Merlin in Dreamlight Valley.
There's something swirling in the air. Could it be... the magic of friendship?
With Merlin, you discover some magical benefits of friendship in the Valley: Fast Travel, collecting items, a special Best Friend Glow, and unlimited Energy each day!
Return to your Villager friend <Lore>tomorrow</Lore> to collect your requested item.
Ask {TargetNPC} what's next on your magical friendship journey.

Hang out with a Villager with Best Friend Glow activated.

(To activate Best Friend Glow, fill up the bar by interacting with a Level-10 Villager.

Try giving them their daily favorite gifts or having a daily discussion!)
Reach a Level-10 Friendship with any Villager.
Ask a <Lore>Level-7 or higher Villager</Lore> to collect an item for you.
